fixture.contract: 48bands2048FFT/512hop/48k; features [normalized real L/R, imaginary L/R, standardized logmag L/R]; PyTorch GRU gate order reset/update/new with reset AFTER recurrent affine; per-stream level/time/global/family state; four12-wide causal GRUs per block/band, full48 temporal projection, current-frame7-band depthwise and8 low-rank full48-band matrices
fixture.quantization: matrices per output-row int8, symmetric maxabs127; LN/bias float; runtime activation scale per vector maxabs127, nearest-even signed[-127,127], exact int32 dot; depthwise activations quantized per seven-band input/channel vector, zero padding counted
fixture.status: assets only; no runtime/NEON, quantization-aware training, acoustic parity, device benchmark or hook integration. Scene status must be read from training manifest; export does not train it. Neural cost is estimated, not measured-device proof.
